contributions.anchor: the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL 26,231.39' on p3, equal to the cover's Cumulative Total cell (26,231.39) - which on this filing also equals This Report, because Last Report is 0.00
contributions.detail: 9 Itemized Contribution Report rows sum to 26,231.39 exactly = the schedule's printed TOTAL = the cover's This-Report AND Cumulative cells (both 26,231.39; Last Report 0.00, so this convention report opens the cycle and the two columns coincide). 2026 is the 3-line variant: one contributions cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line. IN-KIND CONVENTION TESTED BOTH WAYS: the two rows the filer tags '(in-kind)' (931.39 Precision Care and 11,600.00 Precision Care) are INCLUDED - monetary-only would give 13,700.00 and miss the printed total by 12,531.39, so this filer includes in-kind, and the corroborating evidence is on Form B, where the SAME two amounts appear as expenditures (Weber County filing fee 931.39, Gathering Inc signatures 11,600.00): the in-kind goods were the payments themselves.

expenditures.anchor: the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL 13,742.18' on p4, equal to the cover's Cumulative cell (written '13.742.18' by the filer) and to This Report (13,742.18)
expenditures.detail: 17 Itemized Expenditures Report rows sum to 13,742.18 exactly = the schedule's printed TOTAL = the cover's This-Report cell; Last Report is 0.00 so Cumulative is the same figure. The handwritten cover writes the cumulative expenditure cell as '13.742.18' with a period where the thousands comma belongs - that is a WRITING defect in the cover cell, not an arithmetic one, and it does not touch this side's reconciliation, which gates on the typed schedule TOTAL.

itemized.escalation_note: Five 900 dpi tight --value crops, all A3 indexing proofs: p3 row 1 rendered 931.39 and p3 row 9 rendered 5,000.00; p4 row 1 rendered 25.00 and p4 row 17 rendered 125.00; p4 row 10 (one of the three bands I had to extrapolate) rendered 12.90, confirming the extrapolation as well as the endpoints.

itemized.notes: 2026 Weber form: p1 is the HANDWRITTEN cover, p2 a typed Campaign Financial Summary restating it, p3 the typed Itemized Contribution Report, p4 the typed Itemized Expenditures Report - the schedules are spreadsheet printouts, not the county's Form A/Form B grid, and they carry no line numbers of their own (line_no is the 1-based position on the schedule). Office is written on the cover ('County Commission - Seat B') though index.csv leaves office_stated blank. PRIVACY: donor street lines are not carried; on rows 1 and 2 the street line is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (redaction at source) while every other row simply has no street line - two different facts, distinguished in the row notes. Row 3's locality line reads only 'Oregon', which is neither a city nor a US state abbreviation, so donor_city and donor_state are honestly blank. Form B's locality is printed as one 'City ST' string and is carried verbatim in vendor_city, including its non-city values ('Internet'). Two vendor spellings are the filer's own ('pens . com') and are kept verbatim. The cover's own headings are mangled by the scan's text layer ('FilingSchedule(CheckOne') - a text-layer artefact only; the printed page is legible.
